name: Denise Menchaca
office: City of San Gabriel, Member of the City Council

items.text: Denise Menchaca was elected to the San Gabriel City Council in 2017 and served as mayor in 2020 and 2025. She served eight years on the San Gabriel Unified School District Board and was a Los Angeles County commissioner. She is vice president of the San Gabriel Valley Mosquito and Vector Control District and a 211 LA County board member.

sentences.text: Denise Menchaca was elected to the San Gabriel City Council in 2017 and served as mayor in 2020 and 2025.
She served eight years on the San Gabriel Unified School District Board and was a Los Angeles County commissioner.
She is vice president of the San Gabriel Valley Mosquito and Vector Control District and a 211 LA County board member.

items.text: Her priorities include preserving historic character, supporting public safety and managing taxes responsibly. She supports Measure PS, a 1% sales tax increase for police and fire facilities. She says during her tenure, city finances left a state fiscal risk list. She says the city also created a multilingual resident case manager and helped preserve the Mission Playhouse.
